statement: The actual five-primary plus-quartic source and E105 class-two origin descend over G_Q,{2,5}; every finite-S abelian input lifts, with complete R13 x R81 coordinates. For every unrestricted input b+j_r h, the complete class-two image is given by the E108 peripheral tests and the exact restricted mixed correction v_p tensor (F_E,p-1)^-1 h(F_p). Its scalar divisibility/decay form uses the actual local Kummer orders m_p. All central fibres are evaluated by E112. The local orders are unbounded, and actual Chebotarev sets give toric-liftable and compact-liftable inputs whose combination is not liftable.
notes: The actual unit tangent and full free-pro-five centre argument prove the source pullback. The compact primitive retains the E109 f(beta), Hom coboundary, inner cocycle and filling J. No higher Frobenius value is replaced by a graded matrix. The local Kummer phases are retained in the lift inverse; their actual finite coefficient orders determine the image. Later intrinsic quotients and other coefficient primes remain in E23. E.115 completes the actual five-primary and rational-five quartic class-two image and every fibre. The based smooth-source descent has an explicit pullback inverse; every finite-S input lifts, with coordinates Z5^13 x Z5^81. For arbitrary arithmetic inputs the full test consists of all55 peripheral cups and the actual restricted mixed correction. The scalar valuation test retains the exact elliptic Kummer orders and finite-support/decay maps; Chebotarev proves these orders unbounded.
